definitions: To pull something, especially a fruit, flower, or feather, quickly from where it is growing or from where it is attached.
To remove hair or feathers from an animal or person by pulling them out.
To play a stringed musical instrument by pulling the strings with your fingers or a plectrum.
To remove something from a place or situation, often with effort or suddenness.
To show courage or determination in a difficult situation.
examples: She plucked a rose from the bush.
The musician began to pluck the strings of his guitar.
They managed to pluck the child from the burning building.
He had to pluck up the courage to ask her out.
